servicesGrid.title: Integrated services to build your brand presence and execute your projects
servicesGrid.intro: WAF for Business Services combines design, printing, packaging, signage, exhibition booths, event fit-out, and promotional giveaways in one integrated system serving companies, stores, and commercial projects across Jeddah and Saudi Arabia.
servicesGrid.weReceive: What do we need from you?
servicesGrid.viewAllNote: Need more than one service in the same project? Contact us and we'll suggest the best-fit package.

cards.title: Visual Identity & Branding
cards.forWhom: Startups, stores, restaurants, cafés, new ventures, or brands wanting a professional, consistent rebuild of their image.
cards.weReceive: Project name, business nature, target audience, services or products, references, preferred/disliked colors, and any existing logo or files.
cards.weDeliver: Logo, colors, typography, visual elements, identity applications, usage templates, and print-ready files for packaging, social media, signage, and marketing materials.

cards.title: Packaging Design & Production
cards.forWhom: Stores, restaurants, coffee, perfume, food and gift products — projects that need packaging reflecting product quality.
cards.weReceive: Product type, dimensions, required quantity, usage, approximate budget, visual identity or logo, and examples of similar packaging.
cards.weDeliver: Packaging design, print-ready files, suitable material suggestions, production per quantity and budget, and commercially usable outputs.

cards.title: Printing Services
cards.forWhom: Companies and events needing professional prints — banners, brochures, roll-ups, signs, promotional materials, or large-format printing.
cards.weReceive: Design file if available, material type, size, quantity, delivery date, usage location, and required material.
cards.weDeliver: Digital printing, commercial prints, promotional materials, signs, roll-ups, brochures, banners, and ready-to-use outputs for campaigns, exhibitions, stores, or events.

cards.title: Exhibition Booths & Stands
cards.forWhom: Companies participating in exhibitions, conferences, product launches, or commercial events needing organized, clear presence.
cards.weReceive: Booth area, site dimensions, event type, visual identity, participation goal, required elements, installation date, and organizer requirements.
cards.weDeliver: Booth design & execution, printing, signage, visual elements, stands, final fit-out, and installation per site and project scope.

cards.title: Event Branding & Organization
cards.forWhom: Companies organizing events, campaigns, openings, exhibitions, or field experiences needing an integrated visual presence.
cards.weReceive: Event type, date, location, expected attendance, visual identity, required materials list, and any theme or concept.
cards.weDeliver: Visual materials, signs, stands, décor, prints, branded elements, event-site fit-out, and branded products supporting your presence.

cards.title: Interior Design & Commercial Fit-Out
cards.forWhom: Shops, offices, cafés, restaurants, showrooms — spaces that need consistency with the brand identity.
cards.weReceive: Space type, photos or site plan, dimensions, business nature, visual identity, fit-out goal, budget, and opening date.
cards.weDeliver: Interior fit-out, signage, branding elements, commercial décor, in-space identity application, and visual details improving visitor experience.

cards.title: 3D Signs & Signage
cards.forWhom: Offices, stores, restaurants, exhibitions, and commercial entities needing clear, professional presence inside or outside the site.
cards.weReceive: Logo or identity, required size, installation location, sign type, site photos, preferred material, and execution date.
cards.weDeliver: 3D signs, indoor & outdoor signage, wayfinding signs, façades, raised lettering, and multi-material execution suited to the site.

cards.title: Promotional Giveaways & Uniforms
cards.forWhom: Companies wanting promotional gifts, uniforms, branded products, event marketing materials, or brand-carrying tools.
cards.weReceive: Logo or identity, product type, quantity, intended use, target audience, uniform sizes, and approximate budget.
cards.weDeliver: Promotional gifts, product printing, uniforms, bags, boxes, marketing tools, and branded products ready for use.

whyWaf.title: Why choose WAF for Business Services?
whyWaf.intro: WAF's strength isn't in offering a single service — it's in combining interconnected services into one clear execution experience, helping you save time, control budget, and get consistent outputs from first idea to final handover.

points.title: One source instead of many vendors
points.body: WAF combines identity, printing, packaging, signage, exhibitions, events, and giveaways — reducing fragmentation and keeping the project consistent.

points.title: Practical execution, not just ideas
points.body: WAF doesn't stop at concepts or designs — we focus on turning ideas into usable outputs: printing, installation, and handover.

points.title: Fair value for money
points.body: Projects are priced by service type, materials, quantity, and execution time — helping you choose the right solution without unjustified costs.

points.title: Field experience & supplier network
points.body: WAF relies on hands-on experience and a supplier network that provides better options in materials, pricing, and execution.

points.title: Visual consistency across all outputs
points.body: When identity, printing, packaging, and signage come from different parties, results fragment. WAF unifies the look from design to execution.

process.title: How does your project start with WAF?
process.intro: We designed the WAF workflow to be clear from the first message — so you know what's needed, what you'll get, and how the project moves from request to execution and handover.
process.cta: Start now by sending your project details

steps.title: Send your request details
steps.body: Specify the service type, city, quantity or size, delivery date, and whether you have a ready design or need design + execution.

steps.title: We review the need & suggest the best fit
steps.body: The WAF team understands the project nature and determines whether you need printing only, packaging, identity, signage, event fit-out, a booth, or an integrated solution.

steps.title: You get a clear quote
steps.body: The offer is prepared by scope of work, materials, quantity, and execution time — not a generic price that doesn't fit your project.

steps.title: We start design or production
steps.body: After approval, the team begins preparing files, fabrication, printing, or preparing project elements per the agreed plan.

steps.title: Delivery or installation when needed
steps.body: Outputs are delivered or installation & fit-out is executed on-site per the service nature and prior agreement.

works.title: WAF Works: execution that proves quality before words
works.intro: In printing, packaging, signage, exhibitions, and events, images alone aren't enough. We present WAF's work in a way that shows the project type, the executed service, and the challenge we actually handled.

faq.title: Common questions before working with WAF

items.question: Is WAF only a printing company?
items.answer: No — WAF is not just a printing company. WAF for Business Services offers integrated solutions including printing & large-format production, visual identity & signage, packaging, exhibition booths, events, interior design, and promotional giveaways.

items.question: Does WAF only serve Jeddah?
items.answer: WAF is based in Jeddah and serves several cities across Saudi Arabia, with particular focus on Jeddah, Riyadh, and areas where projects can be executed per the request's nature.

items.question: What does 'WAF for project execution & fit-out' mean?
items.answer: It means WAF helps you execute multiple aspects within one project — design, printing, packaging, signage, fit-out, and installation — instead of dealing with separate vendors.

items.question: Can I request just a single service?
items.answer: Yes — you can request a single service like printing, packaging, a sign, giveaways, or stand fit-out, or an integrated package per your project's needs.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Pricing is based on service type, quantity, dimensions, materials, delivery date, and whether the project needs design or production only. Send your project details to get a quote.

items.question: Is WAF suitable for startups?
items.answer: Yes — WAF suits startups and new stores needing identity, packaging, prints, signage, or launch fit-out from one source at a studied cost.

items.question: Does WAF execute exhibition booths & events?
items.answer: Yes — WAF provides solutions for commercial projects and exhibitions including design, printing, signage, visual elements, fit-out, and installation per project scope.

items.question: Do I need a ready design?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Contact us with an idea or initial need and we'll guide you on whether you need design, file preparation, production, or full execution.

items.question: Can I request a quote via WhatsApp?
items.answer: Yes — send your project details via WhatsApp to get an initial estimate or quote based on the available information.
